description: Dictate in Russian with the bb microphone and get punctuated text, recognized on your own machine. On first load the plugin installs GigaAM v3, Sber's open Russian speech model, with a private Python and CPU-only PyTorch, so nothing is set up by hand. A 10-second phrase takes about 1 second on a 10-core CPU, and recordings over 20 seconds are split at pauses, so minute-long voice notes work. Audio never leaves the machine, or you can point the plugin at your own OpenAI-compatible transcription server. Needs Linux (x86-64 or arm64) or macOS on Apple silicon, about 2 GB of disk, 1.5 GB of RAM, and a one-time 1.2 GB download; recognizes Russian only.
